title: force-badtest armhf tests for python-tornado
description:
The SimpleHTTPSClientTestCase.test_request_timeout test is flaky apparently due to a timeout while establishing the SSL connection.

Test logs show it can pass, but after retrying several times without success, I think a hint maybe better suited.

I did not notice this issue on other architectures.
diff:
diff --git a/ubuntu-release b/ubuntu-release
index d3d6e27..613f352 100644
--- a/ubuntu-release
+++ b/ubuntu-release
@@ -81,3 +81,7 @@ force-skiptest apt/2.7.12
 # dpkg already running, some fail to connect to servers like exim4, datefudge
 # has a hilarious off-by-one-second error.
 force-skiptest glibc/2.39-0ubuntu2
+
+# The SimpleHTTPSClientTestCase.test_request_timeout test is flaky apparently due to a
+# timeout while establishing the SSL connection.
+force-badtest python-tornado/all/armhf
